text:
sylvia_cs: Heads-up — Granular Labs has gone quiet. Active seats down ~64% over 10 days; their champion left last Thu. Procurement thread mentions AstraML in a bakeoff. Possible renewal risk.

omar_csm: thanks. renewal date? any billing flags or SSO issues?

sylvia_cs: Renewal in 34 days. Billing clean. CRM shows champion removed; new PM (Ravi) auto-replied OOO.

liam_eng: any 5xx/429/latency regressions? I can pull a quick usage delta.

sylvia_cs: No perf spikes. Biggest drop in nightly embedding jobs and webhook consumers.

liam_eng: I'll run this quick query and grab top endpoints: ```sql
SELECT day, count(distinct user_id) active_users, sum(tokens) total_tokens
FROM events.usage
WHERE account='granular_labs'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 14;
```

renewals-bot: Renewal-30d alert sent to @nisha_rev and @omar_csm for account granular_labs.

nisha_rev: Looping in renewals — if procurement is shortlisting AstraML we should push a narrow pilot + credits. Need committed tiers vs current consumption and top-10 endpoints.

omar_csm: Proposed playbook: 1) 48h outreach w/ small credit 2) tech healthcall w/ Liam 3) ROI + pilot one-pager from Nisha. Agree? :thinking_face:

sylvia_cs: +1. Also request Optimize quickscan (2-week) to show batching/quantization wins. I'll log asks in CRM.

liam_eng: I can prep a p50/p95 latency chart, token breakdown, and a short quant demo. Need ~48h.

nisha_rev: I'll draft a 6-week pilot offer (conditional on minimal usage commitment) and conservative competitor comparison. Attach usage delta and seat churn.

omar_csm: I'll schedule outreach for tomorrow afternoon and lead contact. Sylvia, update CRM and tag as "at-risk — renewal window". Liam & Nisha, prep assets by EOD Wed.

sylvia_cs: Done. Ravi replied and is tentatively free next Thurs AM. He confirmed procurement is collecting comparisons but is open to a pilot if we show clear cost wins.

omar_csm: Goal: convert to constrained pilot instead of full RFP. Move fast. :crossed_fingers:
